system.senses: Notices movement within 3 squares of the tank.
system.passive: Coiled in its display tank; the lid is loose.
system.escalation: Alert 3, tongue flicks toward the crew. Alert 5, noses at the loose lid. Alert 7, out of the tank and hunting.
system.weakness: A heat lamp to bask under, a lid that's actually shut.
system.notes: Note: a Strike that lands drops a Vitality level like any hit.
system.biography:
“Slow to Commit. Then Very Much Committed.”

A large corn snake in a display tank near the counter of the pet store. It watches the crew cross the floor with unhurried interest. Slow to commit — but fast once it does.
